summary.text: Lindsey Port is a Democratic state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 55 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Lindsey Port lives in Burnsville, Minnesota, and earned a degree from the University of Minnesota at Twin Cities.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a nonprofit executive director, advisor and consultant.
Port represented Minnesota Senate District 56 from 2021 to 2023 and has represented District 55 since January 3, 2023, succeeding Eric Pratt.
